Name: PONRSTB
Function: Power-on reset, active low, 3.3 V Schmitt input; tie to aux supply for D3cold wake

Name: SPISO
Function: SPI flash data out to controller (3.3 V input); pull up in all cases

Name: SPICSB
Function: SPI flash chip select; pull down when no ROM fitted

Name: SPISCK
Function: SPI flash clock; pull down when no ROM fitted

Name: SPISI
Function: SPI flash data in from controller; pull down when no ROM fitted

Name: OCI2B
Function: Port 2 over-current input, active low (3.3 V)

Name: PPON2
Function: Port 2 power-switch enable, active high (3.3 V)

Name: OCI1B
Function: Port 1 over-current input, active low (3.3 V)

Name: PPON1
Function: Port 1 power-switch enable, active high (3.3 V)

Name: XT1
Function: Oscillator in; 24 MHz crystal (external oscillator module not allowed)

Name: RREF
Function: Reference resistor connection (value not in datasheet; see user's manual R19UH0078)

Name: SMIB
Function: System management interrupt, active low (open drain)

Name: PERSTB
Function: PCIe PERST#, active low (3.3 V input)

Name: GND
Function: Exposed die pad = ground. Datasheet calls it GND PAD and gives it no number; 49 is our numbering
